AbstractClassWithoutAbstractMethod.fix: Drop abstract if the class is complete, or declare the abstract method; use an interface or sealed interface for a pure contract.

AccessorClassGeneration.fix: Make the constructor package-private, or have callers use a static factory method declared inside the class.

AccessorMethodGeneration.fix: Make the member package-private, or move the access into the owning class and call a method there.

AddEmptyString.fix: Delete the "" when another operand is already a String (i + "x"); when the value is the only other operand, write String.valueOf(value).

AppendCharacterWithChar.fix: Append a single character as a char literal: append('x').

ArrayIsStoredDirectly.fix: Store a copy: this.items = items.clone(), or take a List and keep List.copyOf(items).

AssignmentInOperand.fix: Assign in its own statement before the condition; read lines with reader.lines() or for (String line = r.readLine(); line != null; line = r.readLine()).

AssignmentToNonFinalStatic.fix: Make it an instance field, or a static final field set once at its declaration; a constructor must never write a static field.

AvoidAccessibilityAlteration.fix: Call the public API or add a package-private accessor; do not use setAccessible or reflection to reach private members.

AvoidArrayLoops.fix: Copy with System.arraycopy(source, sourceStart, target, targetStart, length) instead of an element-by-element loop.

AvoidAssertAsIdentifier.fix: Rename the variable, method or class that is called assert, since assert is a keyword in Java 1.4 and later.

AvoidBranchingStatementAsLastInLoop.fix: Delete the trailing break, continue or return that makes the loop run once, or replace the loop with an if or a stream findFirst.

AvoidCalendarDateCreation.fix: Read the current time from an injected java.time.Clock: Instant.now(clock).

AvoidCallingFinalize.fix: Delete the finalize() call; release resources with try-with-resources on an AutoCloseable or call close() explicitly.

AvoidCatchingGenericException.fix: Catch the specific exception types the call throws, e.g. NumberFormatException, and keep the try around that one call; in a test, use assertThrows.

AvoidCatchingNPE.fix: Remove the catch; check for null with Objects.requireNonNull or an if, or fix the code that produces the null.

AvoidCatchingThrowable.fix: Catch the specific exception types the call can throw; let Error and other Throwables propagate.

AvoidDecimalLiteralsInBigDecimalConstruc.fix: Pass the value as a String, new BigDecimal("0.1"), so it is exact.

AvoidDuplicateLiterals.fix: Extract the repeated string literal into a private static final constant and use the constant everywhere.

AvoidEnumAsIdentifier.fix: Rename the identifier called enum, since enum is a keyword since Java 5.

AvoidFieldNameMatchingMethodName.fix: Give the field and the method different names, or make the type a record so the accessor and the component are one thing.

AvoidFieldNameMatchingTypeName.fix: Rename the field so it differs from the enclosing class name; name it for its role, not its type.

AvoidFileStream.fix: Replace it with its Files form: Files.newInputStream, newOutputStream, newBufferedReader or newBufferedWriter for the matching java.io class.

AvoidInstanceofChecksInCatchClause.fix: Write one catch clause per exception type, or a multi-catch (catch (A | B e)), instead of testing e with instanceof.

AvoidInstantiatingObjectsInLoops.fix: Create the object once before the loop and reuse it in every iteration.

AvoidLiteralsInIfCondition.fix: Compare against a named private static final constant instead of the literal; 0 and -1 are fine.

AvoidLosingExceptionInformation.fix: Delete the call whose result is thrown away, such as a bare e.getMessage();, or use its value; to keep the error, pass e on as the cause.

AvoidMessageDigestField.fix: Call MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256") inside the method that hashes, since MessageDigest is not thread-safe.

AvoidMultipleUnaryOperators.fix: Delete the repeated unary operators (!!x, - -x, ~~x) or write the intended single operator.

AvoidPrintStackTrace.fix: Log with the logger and pass the exception as the last argument: logger.log(Level.ERROR, "message", e).

AvoidReassigningCatchVariables.fix: Copy the caught exception into a new local variable and change that instead of the catch parameter.

AvoidReassigningLoopVariables.fix: Leave the loop variable alone: compute into a separate local, or use a while loop with its own counter when you must skip elements.

AvoidReassigningParameters.fix: Copy the parameter into a new local variable and change the local.

AvoidStringBufferField.fix: Keep the StringBuilder as a local in the method that builds the text and return the String.

AvoidSynchronizedAtMethodLevel.fix: Guard the state with a private final ReentrantLock: lock.lock() right before try, lock.unlock() in finally.

AvoidSynchronizedStatement.fix: Guard the state with a private final ReentrantLock: lock.lock() right before try, lock.unlock() in finally.

AvoidThreadGroup.fix: Run and stop the threads through an ExecutorService instead of a ThreadGroup.

AvoidUsingHardCodedIP.fix: Read the address from configuration or take it as a parameter; for loopback use InetAddress.getLoopbackAddress() or the host name localhost.

AvoidUsingOctalValues.fix: Drop the leading zero for a decimal value, or write hex (0x1F), so the number is not read as octal.

AvoidUsingVolatile.fix: Hold the value in the matching java.util.concurrent.atomic class (AtomicInteger, AtomicReference) instead of a volatile field.

BigIntegerInstantiation.fix: Use the constant (BigInteger.ZERO, ONE, TWO, TEN or BigDecimal.ZERO, ONE, TEN) instead of creating the value.

BrokenNullCheck.fix: Fix the condition: use && for a != null guard and || for a == null guard, so the null case is checked before the dereference.

CallSuperFirst.fix: Call super.onCreate(...) (or the matching super method) as the first statement of the override.

CallSuperLast.fix: Call super.onDestroy(...) (or the matching super method) as the last statement of the override.

CheckResultSet.fix: Use the boolean result: while (rs.next()) { ... } or if (rs.next()) { ... }, and read columns inside.

CheckSkipResult.fix: Call in.skipNBytes(n), which skips exactly n bytes or throws, instead of skip(n).

ClassCastExceptionWithToArray.fix: Pass a correctly typed array to toArray (list.toArray(new String[0])) or use list.toArray(String[]::new).

CloneMethodMustBePublic.fix: Declare clone() public when you override it.

CloneMethodMustImplementCloneable.fix: Make the class implement Cloneable, or drop clone() and offer a copy constructor or static copy factory.

CloneMethodReturnTypeMustMatchClassName.fix: Declare clone() with the enclosing class as its covariant return type so callers need no cast.

CloseResource.fix: Open the resource in a try-with-resources header so it is closed on every path, including exceptions.

CompareObjectsWithEquals.fix: Compare objects with Objects.equals(a, b) or a.equals(b); use == only for primitives, enums and identity checks on purpose.

ComparisonWithNaN.fix: Test with Double.isNaN(x) or Float.isNaN(x); a comparison with NaN is always false.

ConfusingArgumentToVarargsMethod.fix: Pass an explicit array of the right type (new Object[] {x}) or cast the null so the intended varargs call is made.

ConsecutiveAppendsShouldReuse.fix: Chain the appends on the same builder in one statement: sb.append(a).append(b).

ConsecutiveLiteralAppends.fix: Join the adjacent literals into one append: append("ab").

ConstantsInInterface.fix: Move the constants into a final class with a private constructor, or into an enum.

ConstructorCallsOverridableMethod.fix: Make the called method private or final, or make the class final, or move the call out of the constructor into a factory.

DefaultLabelNotLastInSwitch.fix: Move the default label to the end of the switch.

DefaultLabelNotLastInSwitchStmt.fix: Move the default label to the end of the switch.

DetachedTestCase.fix: Annotate the method with @Test so JUnit runs it, or make it private if it is a helper.

DoNotCallGarbageCollectionExplicitly.fix: Delete the System.gc() or Runtime.gc() call; let the JVM manage memory, and fix the leak or tune the heap instead.

DoNotExtendJavaLangThrowable.fix: Extend Exception for a checked failure or RuntimeException for an unchecked one.

DoNotHardCodeSDCard.fix: Get the directory from context.getExternalFilesDir(null) or another Context storage method, never a /sdcard path literal.

DoNotTerminateVM.fix: Return or throw to the caller and let main decide the exit code; only main may call System.exit.

DoNotThrowExceptionInFinally.fix: Move the throw out of finally; keep finally for cleanup only, or use try-with-resources so close errors become suppressed exceptions.

DoNotUseThreads.fix: Submit the work to the container's ManagedExecutorService instead of creating threads.

DontCallThreadRun.fix: Call start(); run() runs the body on the calling thread.

DontImportSun.fix: Use the public java.* or javax.* API instead of a sun.* class, or a supported library for the same job.

DontUseFloatTypeForLoopIndices.fix: Use an int or long loop counter and compute the float value from it inside the body.

DoubleBraceInitialization.fix: Build the collection with List.of, Set.of or Map.of, or create it and call add or put in plain statements.

DoubleCheckedLocking.fix: Initialize the value eagerly in a final field (static final for a static); class initialization already defers it to first use.

EmptyCatchBlock.fix: Handle the exception: return a failure value, log it and recover, or rethrow with the cause (throw new IllegalStateException(msg, e)).

EmptyFinalizer.fix: Delete the empty finalize() method; use try-with-resources or java.lang.ref.Cleaner for cleanup.

FinalizeDoesNotCallSuperFinalize.fix: Delete finalize() and clean up with try-with-resources or Cleaner; if it stays, end it with super.finalize() in a finally.

FinalizeOnlyCallsSuperFinalize.fix: Delete the finalize() override that only calls super.finalize().

FinalizeOverloaded.fix: Rename the overloaded finalize(...) method, or delete finalize and use try-with-resources or Cleaner.

FinalizeShouldBeProtected.fix: Delete finalize() and use try-with-resources or Cleaner; if it stays, declare it protected, not public.

ForLoopCanBeForeach.fix: Iterate with for (Item item : items) since the index is only used to read the element.

ForLoopVariableCount.fix: Keep one variable in the for header; declare the others before the loop or use a while loop.

GuardLogStatement.fix: Pass only constants and locals with {} placeholders; for a computed value pass a Supplier lambda or wrap the call in an isLoggable check.

HardCodedCryptoKey.fix: Read the key at run time from the deployment's secret store; keep no key bytes in source.

IdempotentOperations.fix: Delete the self-assignment (x = x), or assign the value you meant.

ImplicitSwitchFallThrough.fix: Rewrite the switch in arrow form, case A, B -> ..., which cannot fall through; in a colon-form switch end every case with break, return or throw.

InefficientEmptyStringCheck.fix: Call s.isBlank() instead of trimming and checking the result for emptiness.

InefficientStringBuffering.fix: Give each value its own append: sb.append(a).append(b), not sb.append(a + b).

InsecureCryptoIv.fix: Generate a fresh IV for each encryption with SecureRandom.nextBytes and store it with the ciphertext.

InstantiationToGetClass.fix: Write the class literal (Foo.class) instead of new Foo().getClass().

InsufficientStringBufferDeclaration.fix: Pass the expected length of the result as the initial capacity: new StringBuilder(expectedLength).

InvalidLogMessageFormat.fix: Make the number of {} placeholders equal to the number of arguments, and pass a Throwable as the last argument only.

JUnit4SuitesShouldUseSuiteAnnotation.fix: Declare the suite with JUnit 5 @Suite and @SelectClasses or @SelectPackages instead of a static suite() method.

JUnit4TestShouldUseAfterAnnotation.fix: Annotate the cleanup method with @AfterEach; a method named tearDown does not run on its own.

JUnit4TestShouldUseBeforeAnnotation.fix: Annotate the setup method with @BeforeEach; a method named setUp does not run on its own.

JUnit4TestShouldUseTestAnnotation.fix: Annotate each test method with @Test; a name starting with test does not make it run.

JUnit5TestShouldBePackagePrivate.fix: Drop public from JUnit 5 test classes and test methods; package-private is enough.

JUnitAssertionsShouldIncludeMessage.fix: Add a failure message to the assertion, e.g. assertEquals(expected, actual, "total after discount"), or use assertThat(actual).as("total").

JUnitSpelling.fix: Rename the method to setUp or tearDown with that exact casing, or replace it with @BeforeEach or @AfterEach in JUnit 5.

JUnitStaticSuite.fix: Delete the JUnit 3 suite() method and group tests with @Nested classes or a JUnit 5 suite; if it stays, declare it public static.

JUnitTestContainsTooManyAsserts.fix: Split the test so each covers one behavior, or compare one whole record or list with a single assertThat(actual).isEqualTo(expected).

JUnitTestsShouldIncludeAssert.fix: Assert on the result, e.g. assertThat(actual).isEqualTo(expected), or use assertThrows for an expected failure.

JUnitUseExpected.fix: Replace the try/catch and fail() with assertThrows(IllegalStateException.class, () -> call()).

JumbledIncrementer.fix: Use the loop's own variable in the update clause, and a different variable name in nested loops.

LiteralsFirstInComparisons.fix: Put the literal first: "yes".equals(value), so a null value cannot throw.

LooseCoupling.fix: Declare the type as the interface (List, Map, Set, Deque), not ArrayList, HashMap or LinkedList.

MethodReturnsInternalArray.fix: Return items.clone(), or expose the data as List.copyOf(items) or an unmodifiable List.

MethodWithSameNameAsEnclosingClass.fix: Rename the method so it is not the class name; use a static factory such as of or create, or fix the intended constructor.

MisplacedNullCheck.fix: Move the null check before the dereference, or fix the condition so it does not dereference when the value is null.

MissingOverride.fix: Add @Override to the method that overrides or implements a supertype method.

MissingSerialVersionUID.fix: Declare private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L; in the class, or stop implementing Serializable if it is never serialized.

MissingStaticMethodInNonInstantiatableCl.fix: Add a public static factory or accessor method, or make a constructor non-private, so the class can be used.

MoreThanOneLogger.fix: Keep one private static final logger per class and use it everywhere in that class.

NonCaseLabelInSwitch.fix: Move the label into a case, or delete it; a label inside a switch body that is not a case is never a jump target.

NonCaseLabelInSwitchStatement.fix: Move the label into a case, or delete it; a label inside a switch body that is not a case is never a jump target.

NonExhaustiveSwitch.fix: Make it an exhaustive switch expression, or add a default branch that throws IllegalStateException.

NonSerializableClass.fix: Make the field's type Serializable or mark the field transient; if the class is never serialized, stop implementing Serializable.

NonStaticInitializer.fix: Move the initializer block's code into a constructor, or make the block static if it sets up static state.

NonThreadSafeSingleton.fix: Initialize the instance eagerly: private static final T INSTANCE = new T(); class initialization already defers it to first use.

NullAssignment.fix: Restructure so the variable gets its value once: declare it where the value is known, return early, or extract a method; never write x = null.

OneDeclarationPerLine.fix: Declare each variable in its own statement: int width; int height;.

OptimizableToArrayCall.fix: Pass a zero-length array: list.toArray(new String[0]).

OverrideBothEqualsAndHashcode.fix: Override equals and hashCode together, using Objects.hash and Objects.equals, or make the type a record.

PreserveStackTrace.fix: Pass the caught exception as the cause: throw new IllegalStateException("message", e).

PrimitiveWrapperInstantiation.fix: Use Integer.valueOf(x), autoboxing, or the primitive itself instead of new Integer(x).

ProperCloneImplementation.fix: Build the result with super.clone() and return it, or drop clone() for a copy constructor or static copy factory.

ProperLogger.fix: Declare it private static final Log LOG = LogFactory.getLog(Foo.class), where Foo is the class that declares it.

RedundantFieldInitializer.fix: Delete the initializer; Java already sets the field to 0, false or null.

ReplaceEnumerationWithIterator.fix: Implement Iterator instead of Enumeration; where a legacy API demands an Enumeration, pass Collections.enumeration(list).

ReplaceHashtableWithMap.fix: Declare Map and create a HashMap, or a ConcurrentHashMap when threads share it.

ReplaceVectorWithList.fix: Declare List and create an ArrayList, or use CopyOnWriteArrayList when threads share it.

ReturnEmptyCollectionRatherThanNull.fix: Return List.of(), Set.of(), Map.of() or Collections.emptyList(), or a new empty array, instead of null.

ReturnFromFinallyBlock.fix: Move the return out of finally, and return from the try or after the whole statement, so exceptions are not lost.

SimpleDateFormatNeedsLocale.fix: Use DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern(pattern, Locale.ROOT) from java.time; if SimpleDateFormat stays, pass a Locale.

SimplifiableTestAssertion.fix: Use the assertion the message names, such as assertEquals, assertNull or assertFalse, in place of assertTrue on a comparison or negation.

SingleMethodSingleton.fix: Keep one getInstance method that returns the same instance, or use an enum singleton or inject the dependency.

SingletonClassReturningNewInstance.fix: Return the single cached instance from getInstance, or drop the singleton and pass the object in through the constructor.

StaticEJBFieldShouldBeFinal.fix: Make the static field in the EJB final; keep per-call state in locals or a stateful bean field.

StringBufferInstantiationWithChar.fix: Pass a String (new StringBuilder("a")), since new StringBuilder('a') sets a capacity of 97 and an empty buffer.

StringInstantiation.fix: Use the String itself instead of new String(s); for a StringBuilder or StringBuffer, call sb.toString().

StringToString.fix: Delete the toString() call; the value is already a String.

SuspiciousEqualsMethodName.fix: Rename the method to equals(Object) if it is meant to override, or to a different name; fix the parameter type to Object.

SuspiciousHashcodeMethodName.fix: Rename the method to hashCode() if it is meant to override, or to a name that is not close to hashCode.

SuspiciousOctalEscape.fix: Write the character as a unicode escape (\u0008) or a three-digit octal escape so the digits are not read together.

SwitchStmtsShouldHaveDefault.fix: Make it an exhaustive switch expression, or add a default branch that throws IllegalStateException.

SystemPrintln.fix: Use a logger, or write to a PrintStream, Writer or Appendable parameter; only static void main passes System.out. An exception fits only without a main method.

TestClassWithoutTestCases.fix: Add @Test methods to the class, or rename it if it is a helper (for example TestInputGenerator becomes InputGenerator).

TooFewBranchesForASwitchStatement.fix: Write the decision as an if/else instead of a switch with fewer than three branches.

TooFewBranchesForSwitch.fix: Write the decision as an if/else instead of a switch with fewer than three branches.

UnconditionalIfStatement.fix: Delete the if with a constant true or false condition and keep only the branch that runs.

UnitTestAssertionsShouldIncludeMessage.fix: Add a failure message to the assertion, e.g. assertEquals(expected, actual, "total after discount"), or use assertThat(actual).as("total").

UnitTestContainsTooManyAsserts.fix: Split the test so each covers one behavior, or compare one whole record or list with a single assertThat(actual).isEqualTo(expected).

UnitTestShouldIncludeAssert.fix: Assert on the result, e.g. assertThat(actual).isEqualTo(expected), or use assertThrows for an expected failure.

UnitTestShouldUseAfterAnnotation.fix: Annotate the cleanup method with @AfterEach (or @AfterAll on a static method) or it never runs.

UnitTestShouldUseBeforeAnnotation.fix: Annotate the setup method with @BeforeEach (or @BeforeAll on a static method) or it never runs.

UnitTestShouldUseTestAnnotation.fix: Annotate the method with @Test (or @ParameterizedTest) so JUnit runs it, or rename it if it is a helper.

UnnecessaryBooleanAssertion.fix: Delete assertTrue(true) and assertFalse(false) style calls, and assert on a real value of the code under test.

UnnecessaryCaseChange.fix: Use equalsIgnoreCase in place of toUpperCase().equals(...) or toLowerCase().equals(...).

UnnecessaryConversionTemporary.fix: Call the conversion on the value directly (Integer.toString(i), String.valueOf(i)) instead of building a wrapper object first.

UnnecessaryVarargsArrayCreation.fix: Pass the elements directly: Arrays.asList("a", "b") instead of wrapping them in new String[] { ... }.

UnsynchronizedStaticFormatter.fix: Format dates with a static final DateTimeFormatter; create any other Format (DecimalFormat, MessageFormat) as a local where it is used.

UnusedAssignment.fix: Remove the assignment, or use the value; drop the initializer when every path assigns before reading.

UnusedFormalParameter.fix: Remove the parameter and update the callers, or use it in the method body.

UnusedLocalVariable.fix: Remove the variable, or use it; keep the call's side effect as a plain statement.

UnusedNullCheckInEquals.fix: Call equals on the value you just null-checked, a != null && a.equals(other), or drop the check and use Objects.equals(a, other).

UnusedPrivateField.fix: Remove the field, or use it.

UnusedPrivateMethod.fix: Remove the method, or call it.

UseArrayListInsteadOfVector.fix: Use new ArrayList<>() instead of new Vector<>().

UseArraysAsList.fix: Replace the loop with Collections.addAll(target, array).

UseCollectionIsEmpty.fix: Call isEmpty() or !isEmpty() instead of comparing size() with 0 or 1.

UseConcurrentHashMap.fix: Declare the shared map as a ConcurrentHashMap.

UseCorrectExceptionLogging.fix: Pass the exception as the last argument (log.error("msg", e)), not as e.getMessage() or a placeholder value.

UseEnumCollections.fix: Create EnumSet.noneOf(Key.class) or new EnumMap<>(Key.class) instead of a HashSet or HashMap keyed by the enum.

UseEqualsToCompareStrings.fix: Compare strings with "literal".equals(x) or a.equals(b), never == or !=.

UseIOStreamsWithApacheCommonsFileItem.fix: Read the upload through item.getInputStream() instead of get() or getString().

UseIndexOfChar.fix: Pass a single character as a char literal: indexOf('x').

UseLocaleWithCaseConversions.fix: Pass a locale: s.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT) or s.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).

UseNotifyAllInsteadOfNotify.fix: Replace wait/notify with a Condition from a private final ReentrantLock: await() in a loop, signalAll().

UseProperClassLoader.fix: Use Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader() instead of calling getClassLoader() on a Class.

UseStringBufferForStringAppends.fix: Build the text in a local StringBuilder in the loop and call toString() once after it.

UseStringBufferLength.fix: Call sb.length() instead of converting the builder to a String first.

UseTryWithResources.fix: Declare the resource in the try header, try (var in = Files.newInputStream(path)) { ... }, and drop the finally that closes it.

UseVarargs.fix: Declare the last parameter as varargs: String... names.

UselessOperationOnImmutable.fix: Assign the result (s = s.trim(), x = x.add(y)) or delete the call, since String and BigDecimal methods return a new value.

UselessStringValueOf.fix: Delete the String.valueOf call and pass the value itself to + or append.

WhileLoopWithLiteralBoolean.fix: Write do { } while (true) as while (true) { }, replace do { } while (false) with a plain block, and delete a while (false) loop.
